text:
Lauren: Quick follow-up from yesterday's RFC review — we still need to decide how the egress multiplexing layer should surface retries to callers. Is it opaque (gateway retries internally) or explicit (returns retry hints/trailers)?
Sam: leaning opaque for short hedging to keep client API simple. downside: clients can't attribute duplicates to retries.
Mohit: can we do a hybrid? expose metadata only when debug flag enabled. minimal overhead normally.
Jia: hybrid is fine but we must standardize the header/trailer names. otherwise consumers will parse different formats. propose `x-rd-retry-id` and `x-rd-retry-origin` in trailers.
Marco: trailers are awkward for some HTTP/1 clients. maybe attach an id early: `x-rd-exec-id` on 1st chunk and trailers optional for final state.
Lauren: good point. Also need to consider streaming cases where partial payloads arrive and we resume midstream. How do we signal a resumed segment vs duplicate?
Sam: protocol idea: every stream frame includes a `segment-seq` and `resume-token` header. resume-token is opaque but monotonic per request. duplicates have same resume-token+seq. cheap to attach (8-16 bytes).
Mohit: adds CPU for per-frame headers. but we can compress by only sending tokens at boundaries and seq within frame proto. still a perf cost on hot path.
Jia: Observability ask: capture `gateway.retry.count`, `gateway.resume.count`, `gateway.duplicate.delivered` and tag with model, route, customer-tier. needs to be present in longtail traces.
Lauren: agreed. Also instrumentation in console should show which requests were served via fallback variant because of retry vs explicit client fallback.
Marco: ops question — if gateway retries opaque and upstream counts tokens, billing may double-charge. we need compensation semantics: annotate billing pipeline with `gateway.retry` to avoid double billing for opaque retries.
Sam: or prefer explicit retries for any request that can have side-effects; opaque only for idempotent flows (embeddings, chat read-only). define idempotency set in route config.
Mohit: we should add route config proto example in config repo. quick sketch:
```json
{"route": "/v1/generate", "idempotent": false, "retry_policy": "explicit_or_none"}
```
Jia: +1, and add `emit_retry_trailers: bool` default false.
Lauren: action items: Sam to draft clear semantics for idempotent vs non-idempotent routes; Mohit to prototype per-frame token with low-overhead encoding; Jia to list metrics & dashboard mockups; Marco to propose billing annotation changes. I'll file a short RFC follow-up with these decisions.
deploy-bot: deployment scheduled: edge-proxy-canary -> prod at 2026-04-03 03:00 UTC :rocket:
Sam: cool, can we gate the canary to only routes with `idempotent=true`?
Lauren: yes — we'll put the canary flag on the route metadata.
Mohit: one last tradeoff note: hybrid telemetry leaks some internal state; ensure PII-free and consider a redaction policy.
Jia: noted. will add redaction rules.
Lauren: thanks all — I'll open the follow-up thread & tag reviewers.
